title: GitHub Portfolio Search
one_liner: Semantic search engine for personal GitHub repositories using embeddings and TF-IDF.
what_it_is: A tool that indexes GitHub repositories, extracts README content, generates embeddings, and provides a semantic search interface via CLI, REST API, and static web UI. It enables developers to find reusable code patterns across their own portfolio using natural language queries.
how_its_built: Built with Python for the indexing pipeline (using sentence-transformers and SQLite-vec), FastAPI for the backend API, and vanilla HTML/JS for the client-side web UI. It uses GitHub Actions for automated weekly reindexing and AWS S3/CloudFront for static site hosting.
how_to_apply: Clone the repo, install dependencies, configure a GitHub token, index your repos, and serve the web UI or use the CLI/MCP server to search your codebase semantically.
quickstart:
git clone https://github.com/davidbmar/github-portfolio-search.git
cd github-portfolio-search
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -e ".[dev]"
cp .env.example .env
ghps index <your_github_username>
ghps export
cd web && python3 -m http.server 8000
features: Semantic search using embeddings and TF-IDF across READMEs and code
Auto-generated capability clusters grouping repos by function
Client-side faceted filtering by language, tech stack, and stars
MCP server integration for AI agents to search portfolio programmatically
Static web UI with shareable URLs and localStorage collections
Automated weekly reindexing via GitHub Actions
